description: Build the NestJS backend API with complete module implementations: authentication (JWT + Google + WhatsApp OTP), RBAC authorization, vehicle management CRUD, booking workflow, payment integration stubs, user verification, and seed data.
steps: Implement AuthModule with JWT strategy, login/register endpoints, Google OAuth handler, WhatsApp OTP stub, token refresh, and guards. Create auth.controller.ts, auth.service.ts, jwt.strategy.ts, jwt-auth.guard.ts, roles.guard.ts, roles.decorator.ts.

Implement UsersModule with user CRUD, profile management, document upload endpoints, driver verification workflow. Create users.controller.ts, users.service.ts, dto/create-user.dto.ts, dto/update-user.dto.ts.

Implement VehiclesModule with full CRUD for vehicles and categories, availability checking, pricing management, image upload endpoints. Create vehicles.controller.ts, vehicles.service.ts, dto/create-vehicle.dto.ts, vehicle-categories.controller.ts.

Implement BookingsModule with the full booking workflow: create booking, admin approve/reject, assign vehicle, digital checkpoint, activate rental, extend rental, return request, final inspection, complete. Create bookings.controller.ts, bookings.service.ts with state machine logic, dto/ files.

Implement PaymentsModule with Xendit payment integration stubs (Virtual Account, E-wallet, QRIS), invoice generation, deposit tracking, installment tracking, penalty calculation. Create payments.controller.ts, payments.service.ts, xendit.service.ts (stubbed).
Implement MaintenanceModule for vehicle maintenance schedules, repair history, cost tracking. Create maintenance.controller.ts, maintenance.service.ts.
Implement NotificationsModule with email and WhatsApp notification stubs, push notification service. Create notifications.controller.ts, notifications.service.ts.
Implement SupportModule for support tickets and basic ticketing system. Create support.controller.ts, support.service.ts.
Implement PromosModule for promo codes, referral system, cashback campaigns. Create promos.controller.ts, promos.service.ts.
Implement AdminModule with dashboard analytics endpoints (revenue, fleet utilization, booking stats, driver retention). Create admin.controller.ts, admin.service.ts.
Create PrismaModule as a global service (prisma.service.ts) that handles connection lifecycle.

Create a comprehensive seed script at apps/api/prisma/seed.ts that populates: 5 user roles, 10 sample users (1 per role + extras), 5 vehicle categories, 15 vehicles (mix of cars and electric motorcycles), 5 sample bookings in various states, sample payments, and promo codes.
Add Swagger/OpenAPI documentation decorators to all controllers.
Add class-validator DTOs with proper validation decorators for all endpoints.
Create rate-limiting middleware and audit log interceptor.
acceptance_criteria: Running pnpm build in apps/api compiles without TypeScript errors
All API modules are properly imported in AppModule
Prisma seed script runs successfully and populates demo data
Swagger documentation is generated at /api/docs endpoint
verification: Run pnpm --filter api build and confirm successful compilation
Run npx prisma db push --schema=apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma to create tables
Run npx prisma db seed to populate demo data
Verify TypeScript compilation has zero errors
findings: Build succeeds with pnpm --filter api build. Prisma db push creates SQLite tables successfully. Seed script populates all demo data (roles, users, vehicles, bookings, payments, promos). All modules imported in AppModule. ThrottlerGuard getTracker uses req.ip. The PrismaModule is @Global so no need to import it in each module.
